# Migration log

Project-authored archive (F15 exemption). Every check in the W105/W108/W109 family is silent here on purpose: this file is over the real word and line budgets, cites an ID that no longer resolves, and carries a rule line far past the word cap, and none of those three are defects in an append-only archive that records what the kit looked like at the time each entry was written.

- Z1. A rule line in the archive that runs well past the real sixty-word cap without firing, because F15 makes this whole file exempt from every check in the W105/W108/W109 family regardless of how long any single rule line or the document as a whole happens to run in an append-only record of what the kit looked like at the time each entry was written.

Cites CLEAN.md X9, retired since.
